title: zesty ukrainian meat borscht
description: grassy and velvety borscht dish that's perfect for a comforting meal in cold weather. This recipe is sugar-free-friendly and features galangal paste for added depth of flavor.
instructions: Combine beef stock, beef, onion, carrots, beets, and cabbage in a large pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes.
Use a blender or food processor to puree the soup until smooth.
Heat the galangal paste in a small pan over medium heat, stirring constantly, until fragrant.
Add the apple cider vinegar and tomato paste to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the vinegar mixture to the soup and stir to combine.
Season the soup with kosher salt and black pepper.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh dill.
Cook the soup using a sous vide machine at 160°F (71°C) for 2 hours.
Alternatively, cook the soup on the stovetop or in a slow cooker.
